about.title: Who we are
about.body: We are TransylvanianBears — the CS team of Tudor Vianu National College. We crack CTFs, ship websites and apps, model 3D worlds, and write code that works. We code at night, compete on weekends, and win medals.
about.body2: We build with Unity, Unreal Engine, Flutter, and whatever else the brief calls for. An indie game today, a drone-based AI model tomorrow, a school platform the day after. Every bear has their lane — security, web, game dev, AI, design — but we ship together.

projects.subtitle: Tools, visualizers, and platforms built by the team — some for us, some for the competitors coming up after us.

join.title: Join the bears
join.body: Looking for a serious team that doesn't take itself too seriously? Drop us a line and you're in the pack.
join.body2: We don't ask for a CV. Show us what you've built, what you've solved, what you want to learn. We figure the rest out together.
join.perk2: Your lane: web, AI, sec, game
